title: 中国AI优势：低成本模型+充足电力，付费客户增5倍能否持续？
speaker: Mary Ann Sung

segments.en: I think I'll answer this in a couple of ways.
segments.zh: 我想从几个方面来回答。

segments.en: One, it's very well understood by the market.
segments.zh: 首先，市场对此非常了解。

segments.en: China has highly effective cost-effective open source models.
segments.zh: 中国拥有高效、成本效益高的开源模型。

segments.en: That's easy to deploy, that's flexible.
segments.zh: 这些模型易于部署，灵活性强。

segments.en: And China has a very large amount of cheap, effective, and efficient power supplies, which is also not a very important component for AI deployment.
segments.zh: 中国拥有大量廉价、高效、稳定的电力供应，这也是AI部署的重要基础。

segments.en: At least for Fancy, you look at our paying customers.
segments.zh: 至少对于Fancy集团，看看我们的付费客户。

segments.en: The number of amount of paying customers year on year compared to the same period last year has grown more than five votes.
segments.zh: 付费客户数量同比增长超过5倍。

segments.en: All those are from large enterprises.
segments.zh: 这些客户都来自大型企业。

segments.en: Those are eagerly looking for more effective, scalable AI solutions, and we are not yet seeing a slow demand in that.
segments.zh: 他们迫切寻求更高效、可扩展的AI解决方案，我们尚未看到需求放缓。
